importantFindings.problem: Both proposed broker status endpoints call sessions.list(), which prunes persisted state; default AuthStore construction also creates a directory.
importantFindings.fix: Add canonical non-mutating session/auth read paths and verify filesystem invariance through the real admin routes.

importantFindings.problem: Recovery does not specify how to verify ownership before the existing stopBroker fallback signals a runtime-file PID, or what to do when process identity cannot be established.
importantFindings.fix: Require verified process identity and actual exit before replacement; fail closed on uncertain ownership or timeout.

importantFindings.problem: Quick Tunnel endpoint changes require connector-update guidance even while tokens exist; the typed user action preserves a pairing code but omits connector action and new MCP URL.
importantFindings.fix: Preserve canonical endpoint-change results in health and lifecycle outcomes and display the required connector-update action.

importantFindings.problem: Authorization semantics are unspecified and the existing tokenCount() can count expired tokens in a long-running broker.
importantFindings.fix: Define authorization from valid non-revoked access/refresh credentials using one non-mutating canonical predicate, with expiry tests.

importantFindings.problem: Reusing resolveInstallationTunnel reaches synchronous cloudflared and wrangler probes with five-second timeouts, blocking TUI keyboard handling.
importantFindings.fix: Make the Manager-reachable executable checks asynchronous and bounded; test responsiveness with a slow probe.

importantFindings.problem: Pausing polling does not handle an already-running refresh, concurrent explicit health checks, or quitting during an operation.
importantFindings.fix: Specify in-flight read handling, single foreground action ownership, stale-result rejection, and exit behavior; add deferred-promise race tests.

limitations: No Manager implementation or terminal acceptance was run.
